body.heading: Where in the world is Cameroon?
paragraphs: Cameroon is a country in Middle Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Cameroon is Yaoundé.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Cameroon speak English and French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Cameroon is the Central African CFA franc. The CFA franc is shared with neighbouring countries, so the same money works across the region.

body.heading: How big is Cameroon?
paragraphs: Cameroon covers about 475,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Tanzania.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Mount Cameroon is one of Africa's largest volcanoes, rising straight from the coast near Buea. Its slopes hold rainforest, waterfalls and farms of tea.
In Cameroon's far north, Waza National Park's open savanna is home to elephants, giraffes, lions and huge flocks of birds around seasonal waterholes.
